messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I remember carrying jithu on my back everyday... My back used to ache but I never stopped carrying him.

output.original_text: I remember carrying jithu on my back everyday... My back used to ache but I never stopped carrying him.
output.joy: I remember joyfully carrying jithu on my back every day! Even though my back would ache, I couldn't stop because it made me so happy.
output.sadness: I remember carrying jithu on my back every day... My back used to ache and I felt a deep sadness knowing I never stopped, even when it hurt.
output.fear: I remember carrying jithu on my back every day... My back would ache, and there was always this fear of injuring myself, but I couldn't stop.
output.anger: I remember carrying jithu on my back every day... My back would ache and it frustrated me, yet I never stopped carrying him.
output.surprise: I remember carrying jithu on my back every day... It's surprising how my back used to ache, yet I never stopped carrying him at all!
output.disgust: I remember carrying jithu on my back every day... It made my back ache, and honestly, I couldn’t stand how much I forced myself to keep carrying him.
